facts.fact: ACSI's director general told the National Assembly's Ecofin committee on 17 November 2026 that the single service-revenue till and the dematerialised local-authority revenue platform, entrusted to ACSI under the 2025 and 2026 finance laws, are ready to go into production during 2027.
facts.system: Caisse unique des recettes de service; plateforme des recettes de collectivites locales
